request: DOE Data-Center Energy Monthly: state-level electricity consumption at monthly cadence, focused on the commercial sector (EIA sectorid=COM) which encompasses data-center load. Two composed EIA v2 sources: (1) retail-sales COM sector by state × month — sales (MWh) and average price — the canonical demand-side signal that the DOE tracks for commercial-sector electrification; (2) state-electricity-profiles/source-disposition — annual state totals for net-generation and supply, tying commercial demand to the supply-side story that drives siting decisions (PJM/ERCOT gas-and-nuclear vs. CAISO renewables). Region focus: 50 US states + DC. The narrative the dataset supports: Virginia's commercial-sector growth curve vs. rest-of-country (Loudoun-County data-center concentration), and how the state's supply mix constrains DC growth. All rows carry `region_type='state'` so downstream Tableau vizzes can filter by state, group by census region, or compare against national aggregates.

sources.name: EIA Retail Sales COM Monthly
sources.description: EIA Open Data v2 retail-sales endpoint, filtered to the COMmercial sector at monthly cadence. Columns: period (YYYY-MM), stateid (2-letter), stateDescription, sectorid ('COM'), sectorName, sales (million kWh), price (cents/kWh). Server-side sorted desc by period to fetch newest months first; paginated at length=5000 per page (EIA v2 hard cap). Auth via ?api_key= appended at request time from $EIA_API_KEY.

sources.name: EIA State Supply and Disposition Annual
sources.description: EIA Open Data v2 state-electricity-profiles/source-disposition endpoint, annual cadence. Columns: period (YYYY), state (2-letter), stateDescription, total-net-generation (MWh), total-supply (MWh), direct-use (MWh). Supply-side annual context for the commercial-demand monthly series; a state whose direct-use is climbing while total-net-generation is flat is a candidate for capacity-constraint analysis.

outputs.name: DOE Data Center Energy Monthly - Retail Sales
outputs.description: State × month commercial-sector electricity sales and average retail price. Source: EIA Open Data v2, retail-sales endpoint, sectorid=COM. Columns: period (YYYY-MM), stateid, stateDescription, sectorid, sectorName, sales (million kWh), price (cents/kWh). Cadence: monthly. Use for Virginia commercial-sector growth analysis and cross-state peer comparisons.
outputs.source: EIA Retail Sales COM Monthly Fetcher

outputs.name: DOE Data Center Energy Annual - Supply Disposition
outputs.description: State × year net-generation, total-supply, direct-use. Source: EIA Open Data v2, state-electricity-profiles/source-disposition. Columns: period (YYYY), state, stateDescription, total-net-generation, total-supply, direct-use (all MWh). Supply-side annual context for the commercial-demand monthly series.
outputs.source: EIA State Supply and Disposition Annual Fetcher
